def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = [sum(v == c for row in grid for v in row) for c in range(10)]
    background = max(range(10), key=lambda c: counts[c])
    choices = []
    for axis, n, m in [('row', h, w), ('col', w, h)]:
        divs = []
        for i in range(n):
            line = [grid[i][j] for j in range(m)] if axis == 'row' else [grid[j][i] for j in range(m)]
            if line[0] != background and all(v == line[0] for v in line):
                divs.append(i)
        if divs:
            choices.append((len(divs), axis, divs, n, m))
    if not choices:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    _, axis, divs, n, m = max(choices, key=lambda z: (z[0], z[1] == 'row'))
    first = divs[0]
    source_len = first
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for k, d in enumerate(divs):
        begin = d + 1
        end = divs[k + 1] if k + 1 < len(divs) else n
        for offset, target in enumerate(range(begin, end)):
            src = offset % source_len
            for j in range(m):
                if axis == 'row':
                    out[target][j] = grid[src][j]
                else:
                    out[j][target] = grid[j][src]
    return out
PY
